title: A Prom for the Mixtape
author: Casper Joubert
blurb: Petra Sterling, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
